name: Even Stevens (Logan, UT) Slow-Braised Pot Roast Dip with Melted Provolone
whyItWorks: Tender, slow-braised chuck roast with melted provolone on a soft French baguette. Dipping in warm beef au jus softens the bread for easy chewing and gentle transit.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pot Roast Dip with au jus; request no pickled onions or horseradish.
watchOuts: Hold pickled onions and spicy horseradish sauce
